name: list_mcp_tools
description: List tools from configured MCP servers (name + description + optional input_schema). Call when an external/operator-wired capability may help and local tools are insufficient. Prefer docs_search / skills / web_* for product and public-web questions. Progressive disclosure — use call_mcp_tool after choosing a tool. Mutating MCP tools are marked and blocked by default.

server.description: Optional MCP server id. Omit to list all enabled servers.
